label: Memory Core
description: Agent memory — a shared store every agent reads, plus each agent's own; manual on/off switch per memory; vault-stored, injected into terminal chats

commands.desc: Search saved memories — /memory <text> searches, it does not save

rejectArg.error: /memory SEARCHES your saved memories, it does not save. Nothing was saved.

commands.desc: Pull the relevant memory context for a topic
Talk to one of your agents — /agent lists them, /agent <name> switches, /agent off returns to AEON
The agent you are talking to writes a handoff note (what it was doing, what is open, the next step) into its folder; it is shown that note every turn until it writes a newer one

beyondNamespace.reason: Long-term memories live in the shared Vault so every block and the Second Brain can read them.

settings.label: Use memories in chat
settings.desc: Inject saved memories into every chat turn. Off = the model sees none.

settings.label: Save memories automatically
settings.desc: After each chat turn, extract facts worth keeping into memory.

settings.label: Most memories per turn
settings.desc: Upper limit on memories considered per turn; the model's context budget still decides what fits.

settings.label: New memories start on
settings.desc: New memories are sent to the model straight away. Off: they are saved switched off, and you turn on the ones that matter (keeps big stores fast).

settings.label: Let agents use AEON's tools in chat
settings.desc: During a chat turn your AEON and your agents may search and read your Vault, list folders, search the web, save to their own memory, scratchpad and folder, and ask another agent. Every tool use and its result is shown in the terminal. Agents set to Local only never search the web.

settings.label: Agents may search the web
settings.desc: Lets the web_search tool send a search query to your search provider (DuckDuckGo needs no key). Never for an agent set to Local only, or while Local only is on in Settings → Models.

settings.label: Continue cut-off answers automatically
settings.desc: When a model stops because it reached its output limit (free OpenRouter models stop at 1,024 tokens), AEON asks it to carry on and joins the parts into one answer.

settings.label: Most extra parts per answer
settings.desc: How many times AEON may continue one answer (0 to 8). Each part is another model call.

settings.label: Write a handoff when you save a chat
settings.desc: When you save a chat with an agent, it writes a short handoff note into its folder, shown to it every turn until it writes a newer one. /handoff does the same on demand.
